audience: managers and HR staff at companies that track attendance, leave and shifts in Just-In

useCases.title: Check the shift roster for the coming weeks
useCases.text: List the shifts between two dates, including drafts, and check the published flag. Open one shift to see its assignees.

useCases.title: Review leave requests for one month
useCases.text: List the leave and absence requests of a month, filtered by approval status such as open. Open one request to read its details.

useCases.title: Approve or reject a batch of leave requests
useCases.text: List the open leave requests, then approve or reject up to 100 of them in one call. Approved leave becomes an absence day in the timesheet.

useCases.title: Check computed monthly hours per employee
useCases.text: Get the computed hours of each employee for one month: 100%, 125%, 150%, 200% and night shifts. Pull a month once its report is approved.

useCases.title: Review attendance for one department
useCases.text: List attendance records between two dates, filtered by department, branch or status. Open one record to see its details.

useCases.title: Draft an evening shift at a site
useCases.text: Find the site and the employees, then create a one-off shift as a draft. Staff do not see the draft until someone publishes it in Just-In.
